walkthrough: ArcVulcan is a welding-tutor project, not merely its public landing page. A fuller implementation is preserved on the master branch.
The session code chooses a topic, produces teaching and a question, and collects the learner’s real reply.
An optional helper predicts an answer for comparison; it is not the learner and does not supply evidence that the learner understands.
Follow-up questions stay on the topic until the programmed rule allows moving on. Required-word checks and heuristic progress values are software decisions, not validated proof of mastery.

evidence.supports: Describes Ontario welding tutor purpose and roles; explicitly states default deterministic tutor stub and intended real-backend replacement.
Actual session selects topics, teaches, optionally predicts, receives real answers, probes, checks required keywords and records topic updates.
Describes teaching, optional prediction, real user reply and evaluation; actual source is used where older docs differ.

review.wrongAssumption: Because the default branch has a landing page, the project itself is only a website.
review.correction: Branch inspection found preserved implementation on master. This view uses pinned product code rather than HTML structure or unsupported marketing claims.
review.remainingUnknown: The current master snapshot has not been executed here. Real-model readiness, certification alignment and learning benefit are unverified.
